abort_rules.when: An installed build, rig config revision or render rate differs from requires.
No sign-off covers the session, or the run record's plan_sha256 does not match the plan.
Citrus computes a protocol_semantic_hash different from the plan's.
Citrus or Orange refuses START for any reason.
Any H5 of the session seals FAILED.
The Orange preset folder the session names is missing on the host or its digest differs from the plan's, or the commissioning release is missing.
The plan file is not committed or has edits.

note: Fish-free. No larva is loaded, so no source dish is declared and MetaZebrobot gets no usage link. Every arena names the same short protocol, protocols/moving_grating_direction_validation.json (21 s, three moving-grating steps, no chaser), suggested by citrus-agent. Each arena is blank and names a protocol, so Citrus gets a blank declaration with a protocol for all four arenas. The camera preset is the 100 frames per second one of the chaser pilot's fish sessions, with the folder digest as it was when this revision was written; a change of exposure or iris after Orange's brightness check gives a new digest and a new revision. Revision 2 changes only requires.orange_commit. The first attempt at G1 on Orange release .7 was refused before any recording by a bug in the runner's re-check of Citrus's declarations; release orange-v2026.11.20 fixes it. The preset digest stood at the brightness check.

preconditions: Projector on before boot or any display-manager restart; projector state read over RS-232 matches the recorded settings (Brightness 50).
A fresh daily registration is run and selected in Citrus (status daily_registration_mode = selected_daily_registration), not base_only.
Commissioning release current for the installed rig config.
Citrus runs with subject acceptance 4, so declare_subjects takes the plan's declarations.
Nothing heavy runs on the host during the session (builds, decodes, hashing).
